# asc_ip (Resource)

Reserves a random IP address.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Reserves a random IP address; it takes no arguments.
resource "asc_ip" "example" {}

output "example_reserved_ip" {
  value = asc_ip.example.ip
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ip` (String) IP address reserved.
- `reserved_at` (String) Time at which the address was reserved.
